data.one_liner: Detects root access on Android and jailbreak on iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that performs offline and online checks to detect rooted Android devices, jailbroken iOS devices, emulators, and unsafe tools. It supports Google Play Integrity API for enhanced security verification.
use_when: You need to detect rooted Android or jailbroken iOS devices for app security.
You want to verify device integrity using Google Play Integrity API.
avoid_when: You require absolute security guarantees from client-side-only checks on heavily compromised systems.
Your app does not target security-sensitive domains like banking or enterprise.
strengths: Comprehensive Android root and iOS jailbreak detection capabilities.
Supports Google Play Integrity API for online verification.
Configurable security policies for custom block conditions.
weaknesses: Client-side checks can potentially be bypassed on heavily compromised systems.
Online Google Play Integrity check requires external Google Cloud setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling the Play Integrity API in the Google Cloud Console and obtaining a Cloud Project Number for online checks.
